prompt: Which release of the software 7-Zip included the patch note, "7-Zip now can unpack DMG archives that use LZFSE compression method." with its release?
answer: The patch note **“7-Zip now can unpack DMG archives that use LZFSE compression method”** was included in **7-Zip 18.01**, released in January 2018.
